title: DIGITAL CORE STUDIO
description: An introductory studio art class using computers in the visual arts. Project-based exploration of digital imaging, layout, 3-D rendering, and video. Examination of the impact of digital technology on the visual arts from contemporary and historical perspectives.
clssnotes:
Hybrid section; both on-site meetings and online component.
